segments.name: Water resource management
segments.description: Operates regulated water, wastewater, and recycled water public utility systems serving communities in metropolitan Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona.
segments.evidence: GWRI is a water resource management company that owns, operates, and manages thirty-nine water, wastewater, and recycled water public utility systems in strategically located communities, principally in metropolitan Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated fixed monthly fees and consumption-based fees for water, wastewater, and recycled water service at tariff rates approved by the ACC.
revenueModel.evidence: Operating revenue is substantially derived from regulated water, wastewater, and recycled water service provided to customers based upon tariff rates approved by the ACC.
